title: Automates Mass Spectrometry Data Processing
text: uafR includes example chemical library: Run standard annotation workflow: Standard mode returns eight tables: Select compounds using database, structure, library-group evidence: Use selected names GC–MS extraction workflow:
code: data("library_data", package = "uafR")  query_compounds <- c(   "Linalool",   "Methyl salicylate",   "Limonene",   "alpha-Pinene" ) annotations <- categorate(   compounds = query_compounds,   chemical_library = library_data,   input_format = "wide" )  names(annotations) reactives LOTUS KEGG FEMA FDA_SPL FMCS FunctionalGroups BestChemMatch selected <- exactoThese(   annotations,   subsetBy = "Database",   subsetArgs = c("LOTUS", "KEGG") ) selected_data <- mzExacto(   data_in = spread,   chemicals = selected )

title: Automates Mass Spectrometry Data Processing
text: Use detail = "research" append normalized PubChem KEGG tables preserving original eight standard tables: Frequently used outputs include: Validate result downstream analysis: Export curated CSV bundle: write Excel workbook, install openxlsx writexl provide .xlsx path.
code: research_result <- categorate(   compounds = query_compounds,   chemical_library = library_data,   input_format = "wide",   detail = "research",   cache = TRUE,   throttle = 0.2,   assay_detail_limit = 0 ) research_result$PubChemProperties research_result$ChemicalTraits research_result$ChemicalTraitOntology research_result$ChemicalTraitMatrix research_result$ChemicalTraitReport research_result$ChemicalMeasurements research_result$ChemicalMeasurementSummary research_result$ChemicalHazards research_result$ChemicalOccurrences research_result$KEGGPathways research_result$SourceCoverage audit <- validateCategorateResult(research_result)  audit$Summary audit$TableQuality audit$SourceDiagnostics audit$Issues manifest <- exportCategorateWorkbook(   research_result,   path = "categorate-export",   format = "csv",   overwrite = TRUE )  manifest

title: categorate — categorate
text: Searches vector chemical names PubChem published information. Uses regular expressions extract information 6 data- bases: LOTUS natural products occurrence database [LOTUS](https://lotus.naturalproducts.net/), Flavor Extract Manufacturers Association [FEMA](https://www.femaflavor.org/), Kyoto Encyclopedia Genes Genomes [KEGG](https://www.genome.jp/kegg/), Food Drug Administration [FDA/SPL](https://www.fda.gov/), Reactive Groups [PubChem](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/). Also downloads structural data SDF format summarize atomic structures common molecular groups chemical. Finally, function downloads structural data chemicals within group input library (`chemical_library`). chemical interest (`compounds`) tested every group chemicals structural overlaps exceed threshold 0.85.

Use data("library_data", package = "uafR") load bundled example library. input_format Designates data structure input library (`chemical_library`). Default setting "wide" can changed "long." detail One "standard", "research", "full". "standard" returns original eight output tables. "research" appends tidy PubChem KEGG enrichment tables, source coverage, derived grouping columns. "full" additionally requests broader PubChem annotations assay summary data. cache Logical. TRUE, enrichment requests cached. used detail "research" "full". cache_dir Directory cached enrichment responses. Defaults user-cache location available. throttle Seconds wait uncached enrichment requests. assay_detail_limit Maximum number unique PubChem BioAssay AIDs per query assay-description metadata fetched detail "full". Active, numeric, target-bearing assays prioritized. Set 0 skip assay-description requests. trait_matrix_profile Trait profile used build ChemicalTraitMatrix. Defaults "core" compact cross-domain matrix. Use chemicalTraitMatrix(result, profile = "full") rebuild wider matrices ChemicalTraits without repeating database requests. trait_matrix_mode Matrix value mode ChemicalTraitMatrix: "binary" 0/1 presence, "count" trait-row counts, "confidence" maximum trait confidence score. trait_matrix_min_confidence Minimum confidence required traits ChemicalTraitMatrix. Accepts numeric score "low", "medium", "high". trait_matrix_max_traits Maximum number trait columns include ChemicalTraitMatrix, ranked prevalence confidence. Defaults Inf. request_fun Optional PubChem request function tests advanced users. used detail "research" "full". kegg_request_fun Optional KEGG request function tests advanced users. used detail "research" "full".

title: categorate — categorate
text: List least 8 data frames: reactives, LOTUS, KEGG, FEMA, FDA_SPL, FMCS, FunctionalGroups, BestChemMatch. Database tables store extracted source annotations chemical; FMCS stores atomic molecular sub-group summaries; FunctionalGroups stores strong (similarity > 0.95) moderate (similarity > 0.85) matches input library groups; BestChemMatch stores top chemicals groups chemical shared strong match . detail = "research" detail = "full", list also includes PubChem KEGG enrichment tables: PubChemIdentity, PubChemProperties, PubChemSynonyms, PubChemAnnotations, PubChemSourceAnnotations, PubChemSpectra, PubChemSafety, PubChemExperimental, PubChemBioactivity, PubChemIdentifiers, SafetyProfile, FEMAProfile, FDA_SPL_Profile, LOTUSProfile, PubChemClassifications, MeSHProfile, LiteratureProfile, ChemicalTerms, ChemicalTraits, ChemicalTraitOntology, ChemicalTraitMatrix, ChemicalTraitOntologyMatrix, ChemicalTraitEvidence, ChemicalTraitReport, ChemicalTraitSummary, ChemicalTraitSimilarity, ChemicalClasses, ChemicalMeasurements, ChemicalMeasurementSummary, ChemicalHazards, ChemicalUses, ChemicalBioassays, ChemicalBioactivities, ChemicalTargets, ChemicalPotencies, PubChemBioAssayDetails, ChemicalTaxonomy, ChemicalOccurrences, ChemicalPathwayRoles, KEGGReactionParticipants, KEGGMatches, KEGGRecords, KEGGIdentifiers, KEGGPathways, KEGGReactions, KEGGEnzymes, KEGGModules, KEGGLinks, KEGGLinkMetadata, KEGGClassifications, SourceCoverage, DerivedGroups, Provenance, DataDictionary, TableQuality, SourceDiagnostics, ValidationIssues, ValidationSummary. normalized Chemical* tables split source evidence discrete terms, traits, classes, measurements, standardized measurement summaries, hazards, uses, taxonomy fields, bioactivity calls, assay targets, potency values, organism occurrences, pathway roles, reaction participants grouping comparative analysis. ChemicalTraits provides cross-source long-form trait vocabulary. ChemicalTraitOntology maps whitelisted discrete traits controlled ontology domains groups preserving source evidence source-backed identifiers available. ChemicalTraitMatrix ChemicalTraitOntologyMatrix provide compact binary wide matrices filtering, clustering, ordination, heatmaps, model inputs. Use chemicalTraitMatrix() chemicalTraitOntologyMatrix() rebuild full, confidence-weighted, capped matrices without rerunning web requests. ChemicalTraitEvidence chemicalTraitEvidence() trace matrix ontology keys back source evidence, IDs, URLs, extraction rules, confidence values. ChemicalTraitReport chemicalTraitReport() provide one compact, researcher-facing row per compound domain signals, evidence coverage, identifiers, nearest ontology neighbors. ChemicalTraitSummary summarizes trait breadth compound trait type, ChemicalTraitSimilarity compares compounds shared distinct traits. DataDictionary, TableQuality, SourceDiagnostics, ValidationIssues, ValidationSummary document expected schemas audit result missing tables, missing required columns, type mismatches, duplicate analysis keys, completeness, source-specific coverage.
